X1.change: LayerNorm (learned scale and offset, eps 1e-6) between the Dense and the tanh of each hidden layer of both critics and their Polyak targets, in RLPD's order (Ball et al. 2023). Actor, demonstrations, seeds, budget, replay, γ, checkpoints and selection unchanged

X2.parent: M4U MPC H40_K32 (the frozen M3 default under U's γ)
X2.change: score += γ^H·V(φ(s_H)) for candidates still running after H decisions; no tail after a finish, failure or the time limit. K, I, blocks, warm start and search seeds unchanged
X2.value: search seed s uses PPO + BC seed s's initial critic and normalization

thresholds.bounded_as_declared: max |Q| ≤ 250 (10× R's largest) at every logged window, and mean Q never above +20 (plan M4X)

bounded_entropy_adjusted.rule: Q' = Q − o_t, o_t = α_t·H_t·γ/(1−γ) from window t's mean temperature α_t and policy entropy H_t: the discounted entropy term of SAC's soft value if α and H held. A critic is bounded if max(q_max − o_t, o_t − q_min) ≤ 250 and mean Q − o_t ≤ +20 at every logged window (2,048 updates)
bounded_entropy_adjusted.why: added 2026-11-17 before any X run (user decision): at γ = 0.99975 an accurate soft critic reads ≈ task return − 8000·α when H sits at its −2 target, so the declared rule cannot tell a blow-up from a large α

thresholds.logging: new runs add per-window q_max and q_min (minibatch extremes) to metrics.jsonl; instrumentation only, training unchanged
thresholds.real_time: p50 decision latency < 50 ms on U validation, 50 ms deadline misses reported (as M3/M4)
thresholds.latency_conditions: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, 3 worker processes (the M4U sweep's settings) and no other experiment process running for the validation run; the tail's own wall time is logged. M4U's H=40 and H=160 latencies were measured while 12 training runs shared the CPU (AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 12 cores of two kinds)
thresholds.predicted_vs_executed: X2 records each decision's best planned score (tail included) and compares it with the discounted return-to-go actually received, from exact replay

selection: Validation only (evaluate.select_checkpoint): most validation finishes, then greatest validation mean return, then earliest checkpoint. Final checkpoints and PPO + BC's initial checkpoint (role bc_only) are reported too.
